name: bloom-vscode
description: Bloom language (.bloom) support for VS Code: syntax highlighting, and diagnostics, hover, go-to-definition, references, completion and formatting from bloomc lsp.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In an untrusted workspace the language server is bloom.bloomcPath or bloomc on the PATH, never the workspace's own bloomc.

bloom.bloomcPath.description: The bloomc binary the language server runs as `bloomc lsp`. With the default, a trusted workspace's own compiler (@oxy.so/bloom-language-compiler in its node_modules) is used first, then bloomc on the PATH.
